title: Impact illustrations
slide_intent: Distinguish two tasks for illustration: drawing attention to a detail in dense copy and carrying a composition when photography is unavailable. Scale changes the task the illustration performs.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can keep reports readable and still give selected messages a distinctly illustrated voice.
demonstration: A small pill illustration marks an article; the same visual vocabulary becomes a focal graphic on covers and layouts beneath the large-scale example.
practical_value: Set the intended reading order before sizing the art. Use a small cue within text, or give the illustration the principal image area.

content_islands.name: Visual cues
content_islands.spec: Introduce the small specimen with a compact text block and a pink arrow to the report example below.

content_islands.name: Large-scale examples
content_islands.spec: Set a second explanation beside the first. Crop a much larger graphic at the outer edge and use arrows to connect the guidance with finished applications.
